title: Inv. Hrs is never blank: no-labor rows show 0.0 and values that round to zero show 0.0 in the default color
custom_preconds: 1. A parts-only invoice (no labor at all) exists in range; if possible also an invoice whose delta rounds to zero (for example +0.04).
custom_steps:
1. Read the Inv. Hrs cell on the parts-only invoice's rows (invoice, asset, customer).
2. If seeded, read the near-zero row's Inv. Hrs.
custom_expected:
1. A customer, asset, or invoice with no labor shows 0.0 in the default color — never blank, "N/A," an em dash, or omitted.
2. A value that rounds to 0.0 (for example +0.04) is shown as 0.0 in the default text color (not +0.0 in green).
3. A negative value shows a minus sign and one decimal — for example, -0.5.
